voss.speaker: voss
text: Auditor. You look like you have had five long days.
The board wants it in one word and I want to be off this moon before my coffee goes cold. So. Is Ithaca Station viable, or do I start loading people?

choices.text: It is viable. Keep it running.
It cannot be saved. Evacuate everyone.
I have read your real orders, Captain. This was never an audit.

branch.if: cond('reactor') >= 60 and res_pct('water') >= 25 and res('air') >= 70 and not flag('dex_left')

viable_ok.speaker: voss
viable_ok.text: Hm. Reactor at {round(cond('reactor'))} percent, tanks holding, air clean. I have seen worse stations with ten times the budget. I will log it as viable. They owe you a drink, Auditor - all ten of them.

viable_doubt.speaker: voss
viable_doubt.text: My own board says reactor {round(cond('reactor'))} percent, water at {round(res_pct('water'))} percent of tank, air at {round(res('air'))}. You want me to put my name under 'viable' on that?

choices.text: Sign it. I will answer for it.
No. You are right. Close it.

viable_lie.speaker: voss
viable_lie.text: ...Your name goes first, then. And if this place kills them, it is your report they will read out at the inquiry.

viable_refused.speaker: voss
viable_refused.text: No. I have buried crews for less than this. I am overriding you, Auditor: we evacuate.

decommission.speaker: voss
decommission.text: Then it is done. Forty years. I will have my people start with the medbay cases. You may want to be elsewhere when the Administrator hears.

orders.speaker: voss
text: ...So the array works again. That was not in my briefing.

Then you know my hands are tied. There is a retrieval team in my hold and a board that wants whatever is under this ice. The crew were always going to be relocated. I am sorry. I did not write the orders.

choices.text: Clause Nine of the charter. A self-sustaining crew may refuse decommissioning. They refuse.
Every word of those orders is on open band the moment you undock.
Take your artifact and leave these people their home.
There is nothing down there any more. The chamber is buried.
Then do what you came to do.

charter_ok.speaker: voss
text: Clause Nine. I have not seen that invoked since Ceres.

They would have to stand behind it, every one of them, and the station would have to hold without us. ...And you are telling me it will. Then I have no lawful way to move them, and I will not be the one who finds an unlawful one. Ithaca is on her own, Auditor. God help you all.

charter_fail.speaker: voss
charter_fail.text: Clause Nine needs a crew that will stand behind it and a station that can stand alone. Look around you, Auditor. You have neither. I am sorry.

broadcast.speaker: voss
broadcast.text: ...You would, too. Fine. The board gets a report that says 'viable, nothing of interest', and I get to keep my licence. We never had this conversation.

broadcast_fail.speaker: voss
broadcast_fail.text: With what? I can have that array jammed before your first packet clears the dish. Do not threaten me on my own lock.

bargain.speaker: voss
bargain.text: The thing in the ice for the station. ...The board would take that trade, I think. They only ever wanted the one. I will write it up so that it reads like their idea.

buried.speaker: voss
buried.text: Buried. ...Then there is nothing here the board wants, and a station is just a station again. I will tell them the audit stands on its merits. So: your one word, Auditor.
